## Setup

#| message: false

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

## Data
The Environment and Natural Resources department makes historical weather data publicly available. A weather station in Dunbar collected data on rainfall, snowfall, and temperature between 1955 and 1982.

source: Government of Canada - Environment and Natural Resources: [Monthly Climate Data Report for Vancouver Dunbar South (1966–1982)](https://climate.weather.gc.ca/climate_data/monthly_data_e.html?hlyRange=%7C&dlyRange=1966-03-01%7C1982-08-31&mlyRange=1966-01-01%7C1982-12-01&climate_id=1108436&Prov=BC&urlExtension=_e.html&searchType=stnProx&optLimit=specDate&Month=1&Day=1&StartYear=1840&EndYear=2026&Year=1978&selRowPerPage=25&Line=4&txtRadius=25&optProxType=navLink&txtLatDecDeg=49.216666666667&txtLongDecDeg=-123.13333333333&timeframe=3)

licence: Open Government License - Canada

```{python load data}
precip = pd.read_csv("en_climate_monthly_BC_1108436_1966-1982_P1M.csv")
precip.head()
```


accreditation: based on Environment and Climate Change Canada data.

## Monthly Averages 1966-1982
Summary statistics help investigate which months have the most precipitation in Vancouver.

```{python summary}
# recode the month column to have month names
months = {
    1: "January", 2: "February", 3: "March", 4: "April", 5: "May", 6: "June",
    7: "July", 8: "August", 9: "September", 10: "October", 11: "November", 12: "December"
}

precip["Month"] = precip["Month"].map(months)
precip["Month"] = pd.Categorical(
    precip["Month"],
    categories=list(months.values()),
    ordered=True
)

# calculate summary statistics per month
month_avg = (
    precip
    .dropna(subset=["Total Precip (mm)"])
    .groupby("Month", as_index=False)["Total Precip (mm)"]
    .mean().round(2)
)
month_avg
```


## Trends in Rainfall
A quick bar plot will help visualize the trend and really highlight which months are wet and which months are dry!

```{python plot}
#| label: plot
#| fig-cap: "Average Monthly Percipitation in Dunbar Vancouver 1966-1982"

ax = sns.barplot(
    data=month_avg,
    x="Month",
    y="Total Precip (mm)"
)

ax.set_title("Average Monthly Precipitation")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90)
```
